title: Special Events Non-Permitted Activity Complaint
description: Use this service request to report someone selling merchandise, food/drink/alcohol, setting up tents, stages, bleachers, or projection technology, with street closures or activations/booths on sidewalks or on public streets that do not have a special event permit from the City's Office of Special Events (CES-OSE). ** Not for permits issued for garage sales, neighborhood block parties, animals, or Dallas Convention Center events. ** The estimated response time for this service request is 24 hours.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about an unpermitted special-event activity.
actions.why: For suspected special-event activity without a City Office of Special Events permit, such as street closures, sidewalk booths, tents or stages, projection technology, or merchandise, food, drink, or alcohol sales. The 311 request form asks what was observed, when, and the nearest cross street or business.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Special Events Non-Permitted Activity Complaint" requests does not apply to garage-sale, neighborhood-block-party, animal, or Dallas Convention Center permits.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Special Events Non-Permitted Activity Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Special Events Non-Permitted Activity Complaint"
